# BO - HelperList: notice if specificConfirmDelete is set to false

In an HelperList with specificConfirmDelete = false, a php notice is displayed in debug mode
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16720275/154533363-72afb92f-d9af-4e1d-ad0f-779fc8a6d9ef.png)

## Attendu
No notice

## Étapes
1. Choose an HelperList
2. set $this->specificConfirmDelete = false;
3. Load the corresponding Admin Controller in debug mode
4. See the notice

ÉTAPE 1 LOCALISER. Réponds en JSON : {"keywords": ["...", "..."]} (3 à 8 mots-clés).

classes/helper/HelperList.php (6)
